name: furniture-v3
prompt: Create a new companion furniture SPRITE ATLAS for this cozy hand-painted fantasy RPG, matching reference wood texture and high overhead 50 degree view. EXACTLY SIX separate isolated objects arranged in a strict 3-column 2-row grid, landscape 1536x1024, generous transparent gutters. ALL pixels outside objects must be true RGBA alpha. No text, no people, no floor, no drop shadows outside objects. Top row: (1) round wooden TEA TABLE with small ivory European porcelain teapot with spout and handle, two handled white teacups and saucers with AMBER brown tea, little biscuits; NOT Japanese cups and NOT green tea; (2) substantial herbalist PREPARATION WORKBENCH with thick worn counter, small raised back shelf of amber bottles, mortar and pestle, chopping board, brass scale, hanging tools and drawers, visibly a working station not a dining table; leave front-left work surface clear for animated hands; (3) GUILD ADMIN DESK with plentiful sealed request letters, tied bundles of envelopes, open ledger, inkwell and quill, mail pigeonholes, compact rustic style. Bottom row: (4) wooden chair in three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, open seat with low back on LEFT for a seated character, no cushion over seat; (5) wooden chair facing LEFT, open seat with low back on RIGHT; (6) empty shop display cabinet viewed nearly front-on, three wide empty wooden shelf surfaces, muted green canvas awning, tiny brass corner fittings, no stock or writing. Every object wholly within its own cell. Strong silhouette, warm inviting storybook game art.

name: goods-v3
prompt: A polished cozy fantasy RPG SHOP ITEMS sprite atlas, exactly 12 separate inventory illustrations in 4 columns by 3 rows. Landscape 1536x1024, equal cells and wide transparent gutters, every item fully within its own cell, TRUE transparent RGBA background, no ground or cast shadows, no letters, numbers or captions. Painted game illustration with readable warm outlines, luminous material textures, ivory/amber/sage palette, slightly elevated three-quarter front view. In order left-to-right top-to-bottom: row1 herb seed paper packet with a green leaf picture and few seeds; carrot seed packet with carrot picture; tiny corked jar of moss spores with moss in its base; open flour sack tied with blue thread and wooden scoop. Row2 basket of walnuts; squat golden honey jar with wax honeycomb emblem and dipper; butter block on unfolded cream paper; small picnic lunch basket with walnut bread and carrots under checked cloth. Row3 porcelain European TEACUP WITH HANDLE and SAUCER, amber tea, ivory ceramic with fine blue trim (not Japanese cup); clear green herbal soda bottle with cork and bubbles; loose fresh green medicinal herb sprig; a shallow basket of dried moss. No card borders. Each is an attractive tactile object a player would pick from a shop shelf.

name: tea-party-v3
prompt: Create a production animation atlas with FIVE characters from the five references, EXACTLY 4 columns and 5 rows = 20 sprites. Portrait canvas, 4 equal columns x5 equal rows, large transparent gutters, true transparent RGBA background. Keep each character's identical head size and body scale within their row. Clean colored anime chibi game sprites matching references. All face three-quarter RIGHT, all are SITTING in midair on an invisible chair, knees bent forward and feet hanging below hips; NO chair, table, floor or weapons drawn. Each holds a small white porcelain European handled TEACUP of amber tea. For EVERY row the four frames are: 1 resting cup at chest and relaxed eyes open, 2 lifting cup near mouth with elbow bending and head inclining, 3 sipping cup at lips with gentle blink and slight head tip, 4 lowering cup, friendly small smile. Feet and seated hip position remain fixed, whole torso breathes subtly. Rows identify DIFFERENT characters in exact order: row1 ARIA, blonde green-eyed pointed-ear elf, green flowered hat and cloak, cream tunic, brown boots, no bow. Row2 LEON young spiky brown-haired swordsman, red scarf, blue tunic and silver shoulder armour, brown boots, sword removed. Row3 MIRA long flowing lavender hair, moon-and-white-flower hair ornament, white-and-blue robe, no staff, sleepy gentle amused eyes. Row4 FINN, 48-year-old scruffy man, brown ponytail, stubble and crow's feet, droopy mischievous eyes, worn dark-brown coat with ochre trim, never a pretty teenage hero. Row5 LICO red messy bun with flower, big round glasses, green eyes, freckles, burgundy dress and black cape, brown sandals. No identity mixing between rows. No objects beside people. Compact 2.3-head chibi proportions, no writing, no frame outlines. Natural distinct hand/head poses suitable for smooth quiet tea-time loops.
